description: Two independent guards. (1) Commit approval gate — a sub-agent cannot commit, merge, or push at all, and a foreground git commit requires explicit human approval. Carve-out: autonomous Index-pipeline runs, marked by WORKBENCH_DEV_TEAM_PIPELINE=1 on the process bin/dispatch-agent.sh spawns. (2) Local-review guard — while a Holmes Local-mode review is in flight, that session's sub-agents may read the human's working tree and run its test suite, and may not mutate it. Each guard owns its own matcher blocks; neither reads the other's state.
